uncited: While the parent article [Scene Representation and Geometry Constraints](15421-scene-representation-and-geometry-constraints.md) establishes the base Gaussian primitives, these methods alter the density function, truncation logic, texture mapping, or proliferation strategy.

They address specific limitations of the base method: [Inverse Multiquadric Splatting](9910-inverse-multiquadric-splatting.md) changes the radial basis function for heavier tails; [Opacity-Independent Gaussian Truncation](10266-opacity-independent-gaussian-truncation.md) decouples visibility from opacity for aggressive culling; [Content-Aware Texturing for Gaussian Splatting](12606-content-aware-texturing-for-gaussian-splatting.md) adds dynamic textures for high-frequency details; [Directed Distance Field (DDF) for Gaussian Splatting](12854-directed-distance-field-ddf-for-gaussian-splatting.md) provides a neural oracle for secondary rays; and [Atomized Proliferation](12935-atomized-proliferation.md) constrains Gaussian sizes for precise geometry.
A transparent Gaussian kernel where opacity is view-dependent, modeled by a half-period cosine function to approximate specular reflectance lobes.
